content.short: Spice AI is a data and AI infrastructure that helps developers easily access Web3 data.
content.description: Spice AI simplifies the data layer for apps and machine learning by removing the complexity of building massive blockchain data infrastructure. Designed for developers embracing Web3, Spice AI's enterprise-grade solution, Spice.xyz, delivers scalable Web3 data and AI infrastructure faster and at a lower cost than in-house builds. With Spice AI, you can query blockchain data using familiar SQL in seconds and get results in JSON or Apache Arrow, ready for use in applications, ML workflows, and libraries like NumPy and Pandas.
